author: reek
body: The geometry pass shared by the deferred-shading and SSAO demos. One GPU thread per pixel ray-casts a cluster of eight spheres and writes a G-buffer: albedo (packed RGB) to buffer 0, the surface normal (each component a byte) to buffer 1, and the hit distance (fixed point, or a large sentinel on a miss) to buffer 2. The lighting pass and the ambient-occlusion pass both read this G-buffer instead of re-tracing the scene -- the essence of deferred rendering. Float math from DeviceMath.
